meaning: The wisdom knot — wisdom, ingenuity, intelligence and patience
note: From “Nyansapo wosane no badwenma”: a wisdom knot is untied only by the wise. Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology carries the symbol and the proverb as its motto.
references: Willis, W. Bruce. The Adinkra Dictionary: A Visual Primer on the Language of Adinkra (1998)
